defense_news.title: Ukraine needs changes to avoid losing war, ousted defense minister says
defense_news.summary: Fedorov, a young reformer whose dismissal last month sparked weeks of protests, said Ukraine lacked any overall vision for how to win the conflict.

defense_news.summary: What form will the Silent Anvil Air-Launched Torpedo, or SAA-LT, take? The Navy wants contractors to explore two options.
